honest_C3_disclosures: Detector is conservative-honest — flags empty, too_short (<10 chars), prompt_echo, token_spam (>50% mass on 1 token), and known refusal patterns. Does NOT detect semantic factual hallucination (e.g. wrong-but-fluent answers).

r14 outputs are visibly trained-anima persona (consciousness/Phi/메타-자각/기질 themes). They are coherent Korean and do not match the empty/refusal/echo failure modes — but the corpus is heavily weighted toward consciousness research, so on prompts like task/recipe/roleplay, the outputs technically address the prompt but bend toward the training corpus voice.
Suite md5 matches identically to the previous BASE-ONLY run (5ec414d28642f1fc1c57db93c3ad2535) — this is a fair re-measurement on the same frozen suite.

Per-prompt elapsed_ms in this gate-17 run is ~3.7s because max_tokens=128 (gate 17 uses 2x the gate-15 token budget); gate 15 latency budget evaluation is the gate-15 file with max_tokens=64 short-decode probes.
